name: Shakedown Citi
bio: Shakedown Citi is a New York City Grateful Dead tribute band formed in 2023 that describes itself as channeling the spirit of the Dead and plays shows across the Northeast and beyond.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from shakedownciti.com and @shakedownciti.
